works.title: The Siege of Amenti
works.source: Ian Ingram, The Siege of Amenti (2026) · Ingram Manor LLC · Atlantica Chronicle
works.note: The chronicle of the Fourth of July campaign, told as an epic naval saga: a captain and an army of coded ships descend into the underworld to steal the keys and open the gates of Amenti, Valhalla, and Hades. The invocation tolls, the fleet musters, the Glass is besieged — and at the gates, the docket seeds itself. “The bell was struck before it rang — the code beneath the code, it sang.”

works.title: Keeping Your Powder Dry
works.source: Ian Ingram, Keeping Your Powder Dry (2026) · Ingram Manor LLC · Field Engineering Journal
works.note: The technical field journal behind the Siege — the campaign's doctrine, the two-layer architecture, the six false-verdict artifact species, the keys as shipped code, and the self-seeding twist that rewrote the ending. Hidden behind the story: read the Chronicle first. “The finding you were not looking for is the finding.”

works.title: The Voice That Carries
works.source: Ian Ingram, Amenti Field Journal II (2026) · Ingram Manor LLC
works.note: The architect's account of the build that turned a site that speaks into a studio that broadcasts — the pipeline, the archive going live, the host, and the newsroom. “I built the halls so the past could answer back, in its own voice, and now that voice carries.”

works.title: The Mind That Speaks
works.source: Ian Ingram, Amenti Field Journal (2026) · Ingram Manor LLC
works.note: The first field journal — how a website learned to think and speak: the sawmill dead end, the shift to thought and voice as separate faculties, and the architecture that now stands. “The brain receives content, then loads speech.”

works.title: Built in the Mind's Image
works.source: Ian Ingram, Built in the Mind's Image (2026) · Ingram Manor LLC
works.note: The product thesis — the Amenti Neural Interface built in the brain's image: cognition, articulation, and memory, three faculties bound into one act. “The mind forms the thought, then gives it voice.”

works.title: The Ledger and the Scale
works.source: Ian Ingram, The Ledger and the Scale (2026) · Ingram Manor LLC
works.note: A technical debrief on the Amenti Emerald economy and the building of the Cosmic Court — a ledger that mints, a community that judges, a pool that pays, and a threshold that makes it mythic. “The machine is whole; the theatre is next.”
